description: Refused to call the afternoon a mending, and would not shut a bag on it.
name: John Heminges

description: Had a doublet that met, and would not call that a victory.
name: John Sincler

description: Came through the dry place once and apologised to nobody.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Counted once against Tuesday's four, and would not add them into a new play.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Said the eight lines held, and that he was not proud of them.
name: William Shakespeare
